title: 10 Day Portugal Road Trip (2026)
description: The complete 10-day Portugal road trip guide: Lisbon, Sintra, Porto, Douro Valley, and the Algarve coast with driving tips, toll advice, and local recommendations.

days.neighborhoods: Belém · Chiado · Cais do Sodré · Santos
days.title: Belém, Pastéis de Nata & Time Out Market

activities.name: Pastéis de Belém
activities.description: Start at Pastéis de Belém (Rua de Belém, 84–92) — the original home of the pastel de nata since 1837. The recipe is a closely guarded secret from the Jerónimos Monastery monks. Arrive before 9:00 AM to skip the queue (it wraps around the block by 10:00).

activities.name: Time Out Market (Mercado da Ribeira)
activities.description: Head back to Time Out Market (Avenida 24 de Julho, Cais do Sodré) — a curated food hall featuring Lisbon's best chefs under one roof. Open daily until midnight.

days.title: Sintra Day Trip — Fairytale Palaces & Europe's Edge

activities.name: Palácio da Pena
activities.description: Bus 434 from Sintra station to Pena Palace (€14 palace + park, book online). A wildly colorful 19th-century Romanticist castle on a hilltop surrounded by cloud forest. The interior is equally eccentric — every room a different style. Allow 1.5–2 hours.

days.neighborhoods: Vila Nova de Gaia · Clérigos · Bolhão · Livraria Lello
days.title: Port Wine Cellars & Livraria Lello

activities.name: Vila Nova de Gaia
activities.description: Cross the Ponte Dom Luís I to Vila Nova de Gaia — the south bank lined with port wine cellars (caves). This is where all port wine ages in barrels.

days.title: Douro Valley — Wine, Vineyards & River Cruise

activities.name: Wine Tasting at a Quinta
activities.description: Visit a quinta (wine estate) for a tour and tasting:

activities.name: Douro River Cruise
activities.description: Take a Douro River cruise from Pinhão — 1-hour cruises (€15–20) pass through the most scenic stretch of the valley. Companhia Turística do Douro and Tomaz do Douro run regular departures. The views of the terraced vineyards from river level are unforgettable, especially in late afternoon light. Lunch: Eat at DOC Restaurant (Estrada Nacional 222, Folgosa) — a modern Portuguese restaurant literally floating on the Douro. Chef Rui Paula serves seasonal dishes with valley views. Lunch menu €25–40. One of Portugal's best restaurants. Book ahead.

days.title: The Big Drive South — Porto to Lagos

activities.name: Algar de Benagil
activities.description: Drive to Benagil Beach (30 min east from Lagos). The Benagil Cave (Algar de Benagil) is the Algarve's most famous natural wonder — a sea cave with a collapsed ceiling creating a natural skylight over a hidden beach.

days.title: Sagres & the End of the World

activities.name: Cabo de São Vicente
activities.description: Drive 5 minutes to Cape St. Vincent (Cabo de São Vicente) — the southwestern tip of mainland Europe. A lonely lighthouse stands on 75-meter cliffs battered by Atlantic winds. The sense of standing at the end of the continent is powerful. Buy a bratwurst from the famous "last bratwurst before America" van (€4) — an ironic tradition run by a German expat. It's genuinely good.
